correctness.rationale: Six-step proof: (i) exactly two quotient-weight orbits for each index-four kernel; (ii) restriction to Klein-four forbids each missing collapse; (iii) first-nonunit kernel rigidity yields a required double-coset generator; (iv) exact stabilizer invariance separates H; (v) known elementary collapse generation and Lemma 3.14 supply sufficiency; (vi) rank-two quotient kernels counted by surjections modulo GL2(F2). The attached checker exhaustively confirms 1,7,35,155 kernels and two H-orbits for r<=3; these are auxiliary finite checks, not infinite/group-uniform proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies how many distinct nonlazy maps must be added to complete a proper dynamically defined transformation monoid and classifies EVERY valid set of supplements, not just a minimum. The quotient rank r distinguishes groups with identical yes/no Klein-quotient obstruction but wildly different quantitative cost (r=2,3,4,5 yields 1,7,35,155). The structural hitting criterion is necessary and sufficient for all finite groups, a naturally motivated extension of a fresh qualitative result.
